## Unresolved qualification gaps and interview risks

- No documented SRE ownership of production-scale CPU/GPU fleets, fault-tolerant storage, networking or distributed control planes.
- No verified on-call production incidents, SLOs, fleet capacity management or scheduler-infrastructure ownership.
- Published base range alone is not clearly above $286k; equity and actual level are necessary for a compensation-positive move.

## Hiring-manager assessment

Outstanding direct EDA application-domain relevance with credible Linux and automation engineering, but an infra-focused hiring panel may prioritize candidates with actual multi-thousand-node compute-fleet operations. It is a plausible stretch, not a demonstrated distributed-systems operations specialization.
